rationale: The grader contract, checks and executed controls are sound and mutually consistent. The single scientific endpoint (the two 'original_' radiomics feature signatures, keyed by canonical name, per case) is fully preserved from the source notebook; excluded notebook artifacts (plots, unkeyed plotting arrays, the transient plt.plot difference, diagnostics) are either display-only consumers of the exported values or fully derivable from them, so no independent scientific information is lost. The grader compares dynamically against the reference (no hardcoded values, shapes, counts or hashes in the grader itself); identity, case-pairing, feature-set equality, nonfinite/empty/unparseable handling, tolerance boundary and representation freedoms are all enforced and verified by 14/14 executed controls with the expected outcomes, including a byte-different independent run and eight probes. Placement records confirm the correct path semantics and that the outputs/-nested variant fails as publicly stated. Advisory (non-blocking) notes: (a) public acceptance rule 4's claim that the tolerance 'only absorbs last-bit floating-point reordering between numerical builds' overstates the evidence — only within-pinned-environment byte-identical replays and one same-stack independent run exist, and the ~2e-9 to 2e-8 relative band is untested; the formula itself is published exactly and the boundary probe (2e-8) genuinely fails, so this is a wording fix only, not an acceptance defect; (b) all reference complex cells have exactly zero imaginary parts, so complex serialization could only be validated negatively (invented imaginary parts, malformed text), which the candidate's concerns already acknowledge; (c) a CSV ending with a blank line yields a zero-field row that fails csv_table_structure, consistent with the published exactly-three-fields rule — disclosed strictness, not a defect. None of these weakens the scientific rule, the executed evidence or the controller interface.

source_coverage.rationale: Approve: audit of inputs/original.py, inputs/exports.py, inputs/plan.json and the resulting reference output shows the source's terminal scientific results are fully preserved. The notebook's endpoint results are result_1/result_2 from extractor.execute under the supplied Params.yaml; the exported radiomics_features.csv preserves exactly the notebook's own terminal selection (features starting with 'original_', diagnostics/meta-features excluded by the notebook's own filtering rule) for both cases in a name-keyed table that also fully determines the notebook's comparison purpose. Exclusions were independently audited and are source-backed: diagnostics_* keys are provenance metadata explicitly excluded by the notebook's own 'excluding meta-features' rule; feature_1/feature_2 and the plotted difference (feature_1 - feature_2) are, respectively, unkeyed duplicates of the exported values and the elementwise difference of the two exported columns, computed only inside plt.plot for display of already-exported values, so they are downstream display consumers whose entire numerical content is reconstructible from the exported endpoint, not independent scientific results; the brain image/label display is visualization of staged inputs, not an analysis endpoint. No filtered image types appear in the pinned configuration's extraction output (all 100 reference rows are original_*), so no filtered branch of the extraction was dropped; both cases are verified to share the identical feature-name set (reference profile shows no empty cells, and feature_name_set passes against the independently executed solution), so the export's result_1-keyed read does not drop brain2-only features. Complex-valued eigenvalue-derived shape features are preserved verbatim rather than truncated, matching the source's np.append behavior and the public contract. No endpoints are missing from the source, and export code, preparation plan, instruction and grader agree on the selected output.
remaining_validation: Cross-implementation numeric agreement (different pyradiomics/SimpleITK builds or forks) is unmeasured: only byte-identical replays within the pinned environment and one same-stack independent execution exist; later oracle/isolation packaging checks, not this review, would establish any further claim.
No positive non-zero imaginary reference value exists in this data, so acceptance of genuinely complex (nonzero-imaginary) serialization could only be validated negatively via mutation probes.
